title: Method for the identification of pharmacological intervention for the disruption of fear memory in PTSD-rat model
author: Haider, Batool, et al.

steps.title: Habituate rats
steps.instruction: Place each rat in the training chamber for 15 min to allow habituation before any conditioning.

steps.title: Fear conditioning training
steps.instruction: On the following day, deliver three CS‑US pairings in the training chamber: a 20 s, 5 kHz, 75 dB tone (CS) co‑terminated with a 1 s foot shock of 0.5 mA (US).

steps.title: Consolidation disruption
steps.instruction: Test disruption of memory consolidation by administering the drug immediately after training and then assessing memory at short‑ and long‑term intervals.

substeps.instruction: Administer the test drug immediately after the training session.
Assess short‑term memory 2 h after training by presenting three CS trials (tone only).
Assess long‑term memory 24 h after training by presenting ten CS trials (tone only).

steps.title: Reconsolidation disruption
steps.instruction: Test disruption of memory reconsolidation by reactivating the memory 24 h after training, administering the drug, and then assessing memory.

substeps.instruction: Reactivate the fear memory 24 h after training by placing the rat in the testing chamber and presenting a single CS (tone) without shock.
Administer the test drug immediately after the reactivation session.
Assess short‑term memory 2 h after reactivation by presenting three CS trials (tone only).
Assess long‑term memory 24 h after reactivation by presenting ten CS trials (tone only).
